pivHint: A shipyard worker will WELD steel plates - but to WELD a team together means to do what?
winText: Stronger together. WELD was the pivot - joining metal to a UNITEd team.
lossText: UNITE - to WELD together. WELD was the pivot: joining steel to uniting a team.
